inputs.xtext_rule_text:
OwnedFeatureTyping returns SysML::FeatureTyping :
	  type = [SysML::Type | QualifiedName]
	| ownedRelatedElement += OwnedFeatureChain
;

decision: As SysML 8.2.2.6.5 states it: `type = [QualifiedName]`, or `type = OwnedFeatureChain` with the chain owned by the relationship. The cross-reference parses a QualifiedName. The `{ ownedRelatedElement += ... }` action consumes no tokens. This is the SysML variant (ADR-0014). The Xtext states the same two alternatives.

evidence.note: OwnedFeatureTyping : FeatureTyping = type = [QualifiedName] | type = OwnedFeatureChain { ownedRelatedElement += ... }
line 74: `part vehicle : Vehicle, SpatialItem {`, two qualified names
OwnedFeatureTyping: type = [SysML::... | QualifiedName] | ownedRelatedElement += OwnedFeatureChain. Agrees.
